n: Event <When Elegies Are Ashes> is now open

missions: Clear event stages 15 times, not including tutorial stages
Clear event stages 45 times, not including tutorial stages
Clear event stages 85 times, not including tutorial stages

theme: Traditional Taran hut, recreated from the depiction of Na Saoirsí homes by a certain writer. A fire burns in the hearth, and nothing has changed from when the master of the house left, as though forgotten by time.

list:
You learned what happened at the wake on the eve of that Samhain.
May the flame that burns all to ashes become the lamp that drives out cold and darkness.
During the When Elegies Are Ashes event, obtain the free Operator Brigid.

You befriended the descendant of one who cast aside the crown.
Resolve and kindness are hereditary too.
During the When Elegies Are Ashes event, spend 2400 Broken Originium Lamps.

You recovered the Originium lamps of the departed, returning them to those who still remember.
Take heart, for not everyone is fortunate enough to be remembered in this place.
Complete all stages in [Flickering Shadows] with 3-star ratings (excluding tutorials).

You heard out the story told by one who lost his words.
Losing his words was the last dignity afforded to him.
Complete all the content in [Griefs yet to Relieve] and collect the rewards.

You are confident that Na Saoirsí's winter will be bright and warm.
'And so in my dreams I go, lighting bonfires in the woods, lighting the path you trod.'
Defeat a total of 100 Cabbage Seedlings and Cabbage Weeds in the event.

You eliminated many strange saplings from the Dark Woods.
Would they still grow into plants, if the black mist were dispersed?
Expose 15 'End Points' and 'Middle Points' early in the event.

You met the mischievous fae of the Dark Woods.
Would they be satisfied with mere pranks, if the sun shone into the woods?
Complete all stages in [Dying Flames] on Challenge Mode.

You followed the fire to walk the path of the living, leaving the departed behind.
The elegy that has been sung for a thousand years shall turn to ashes with the rising sun.
Clear EA-4 with a 3-star rating and allow no more than 6 Thickets to spawn.

You stopped the withered branches from growing out of control in the Dark Woods.
Do not allow them to twist everything touched by the black mist.
Clear EA-8 with a 3-star rating and allow 'All Flames Returned' to revive and re-enter the Spin state no more than 3 times.

Time and again, you denied the purple fire its fuel, until it is extinguished from Tara.
When the sun rises, life will truly begin.
set: When Elegies Are Ashes Engraved Medal Set

An engraved medal set depicting a story based on the Na Saoirsí Incident.
No story can tell you whether it is itself a true flame, or merely its shadow cast on the wall. But you may have your answer already.
